apps.name: ArchaeaPhoto
apps.description:
A layered image editor for retouching, compositing and digital painting.

Work with layers, groups, masks and blend modes. Paint with the brush, eraser and clone stamp; select with marquee, lasso and magic wand; add text, shapes and gradients; crop and transform. Adjust brightness, contrast, exposure, levels, curves, saturation and colour balance, and blur, sharpen or reduce noise.

Opens and exports PNG, JPEG, WebP and TIFF, and saves layered projects in the open .archa format. Works fully offline.
apps.releaseNotes:
First preview release.
- Layers, groups, masks and 17 blend modes
- Brush, eraser, clone stamp, fill, gradient, text and shapes
- Selections, crop and free transform
- Adjustments and filters with live preview
- PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF and layered .archa projects

apps.name: ArchaeaIDE
apps.tagline: A code editor and IDE with a terminal, Run button, debugger and Git.
apps.description:
A fast code editor for writing, running and debugging programs.

Edit with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, a minimap, multiple cursors, split editors and a command palette. Browse a project folder, search and replace across files, and work in an integrated terminal. Press Run to start Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C, C++, C#, Java, Go, Rust and more with the tools you have installed. Set breakpoints and inspect variables in Python and Node.js programs. Commit, branch and compare changes with Git.

Also included: project templates, tasks, customisable shortcuts, sandboxed extensions and an optional assistant that uses a model running on your own computer. Works fully offline.
apps.releaseNotes:
First preview release.
- Editor with IntelliSense for JavaScript, TypeScript, JSON, CSS and HTML, and language servers for other languages
- File explorer, search and replace, integrated terminal
- Run and Stop for many languages; debugging for Python and Node.js
- Git: commit, branches, diffs
- Project templates, tasks, extensions, shortcuts and optional local AI

apps.name: Archaea Hello
apps.tagline: A tiny test app that proves install, launch and update work.
apps.description:
Archaea Hello is the smallest possible real application. It opens a window showing its version and how many times it has been launched.

It exists so the launcher can be tested end to end against a genuine GitHub release. Install it, launch it, update it and remove it to see the whole lifecycle before the creative apps arrive.
apps.releaseNotes:
A small update, published to prove the update path.
- The window now reports version 1.1.0
- Your launch count carries over from 1.0.0
